Recompute the tier-stratified benchmark table from build_full_feature_table()

build_benchmark_table_from_full.Rd

Produces the identical column layout as build_benchmark_table, but every count (n_MS1Match, n_CAMERA_grouped/recall, n_CAMERA_split/split, n_CAMERA_unassigned) is aggregated directly from ref_status on full_table — the same row-level object exported for manual inspection — rather than from the separately computed compound_eval_wide pathway. Running both build_benchmark_table() and this function and comparing output is a useful consistency check: any divergence indicates the two pipelines have drifted out of sync somewhere upstream.

Annotation coverage/accuracy (CAMERA_coverage_pct, CAMERA_annotation_accuracy_pct) are NOT re-derived here — they depend on a ppm-tolerance match between CAMERA's own adduct call and the expected mass, a different computation axis from ref_status entirely — and are still sourced from anno_accuracy$summary, same as build_benchmark_table().

Usage

build_benchmark_table_from_full(full_table, anno_accuracy)

Arguments

full_table

data.frame. Output of build_full_feature_table. Must contain ref_status and MS1Match_reference_tier.

anno_accuracy

list. Output of build_anno_accuracy.

Value

A data.frame, one row per tier plus TOTAL, with columns: Tier, n_MS1Match, n_CAMERA_grouped, recall_pct, n_CAMERA_split, split_pct, CAMERA_coverage_pct, CAMERA_annotation_accuracy_pct, CAMERA_has_concept, n_CAMERA_unassigned, unassigned_pct.

See also

build_full_feature_table, build_benchmark_table
